asset.name: ColorPicker
asset.description: The colour field with swatches, spectrum, channel entry, text input, alpha, contrast feedback against a target background, recent values, and normalized output formats.

requires.reason: Spectrum selection keeps pointer movement outside React rendering.

rationale: Already implemented in the catalog at 1.0.0. The contrast-feedback capability is the part worth keeping: a colour picker that lets you choose an unreadable pair without saying so is actively harmful in a design system.
